title: Plague Akwin
extract:
The Plague Akwin is an Infested Grip for Zaws.

Acquisition
Plague Akwin is obtainable from limited-time events:
Operation: Plague Star sold Plague Akwin from Nakak for  2,000 +  3,500, requiring Rank 3 - Champion with Operational Supply.
The October 2020, 2022, and 2024 Nights of Naberus event sold Plague Akwin from Daughter for 25  Mother Tokens each.
While the actual Grip itself cannot usually be acquired outside of events, it can still appear as part of a complete Zaw in Hok's Daily Specials.

Notes
The Plague Akwin creates the following weapon types:

Sword
Machete
Rapier
Dagger
Nikana
Scythe
